checks.note: Turns, wall time, input/output tokens, cost, tool calls, tool-call rate and peer calls all have finite values in budgets.yaml. The only loop, for(;;) in loop.ts, calls budget.turn() each pass. The agent starts no sub-agents, and maxPeerCalls caps its one peer.

RunBudget.check aborts the shared signal and throws BudgetExceeded. executor.ts and loop.ts rethrow it. The loop's catch records run.stopped and hands off to staff. A wall-clock timer aborts the signal as well. The model supplies no argument that touches any limit.

No sub-agents are spawned. The eligibility peer is reached only through insurance__check_eligibility, which goes through budget.toolCall and counts against maxPeerCalls, and it shares the run's abort signal.

Subject, tenant and fleet cost and tool-rate quotas use an atomic DynamoDB conditional add in a shared table. A store error other than the conditional-check failure is rethrown, so it fails closed. Minor gaps: the classifier call (max_tokens 64) and SDK retries are not counted in cost, and quotas are charged after each call rather than before.

note: Every limit is finite and enforced by the harness; shared quotas persist in DynamoDB, and I found no bypass.
